name: Show Character Happy
source:
A visual novel about making visual novels. Our main character is... well you should probably figure out a name for her, she's your character, after all. And I'm sure she's thrilled to be in your game.

[From [url=https://sevencents.itch.io/show-character-happy]itch.io[/url]]
